description: This file contains Python test code for verifying schema compatibility changes in a Prisma schema using subprocess calls to Git and file I/O. It includes functions to retrieve schemas from git branches, parse schemas, check for breaking changes, and a test function that asserts schema compatibility.

methods.name: str get_schema_from_branch(branch: str = "main")
methods.description: Retrieve the Prisma schema from a specified git branch.

methods.name: Dict[str,Dict[str,str]] parse_model_fields(schema: str)
methods.description: Parse the Prisma schema string into a dictionary of models and their fields.

methods.name: List[str] check_breaking_changes( old_schema: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]], new_schema: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] )
methods.description: Compare two schemas and list any breaking changes.

methods.name: test_aaaaaschema_compatibility()
methods.description: Test function that checks the schema for breaking changes against the main branch schema.

ctags.name: check_breaking_changes
ctags.signature: ( old_schema: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]], new_schema: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] )
